text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Bright-san!
They say that one over there is
the biggest elephant in the whole zoo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~.
Its trunk is so very, ve~ry long, isn't it~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, I paid a visit to the zoo
and spotted an exceptionally cheerful pair.

text_block_list.name: Bright & Elephant
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~...
Pawooo~...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
You two are totally on the same wavelength!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There's a giraffe further back too!
Whoa, it's so~ tall!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, no, hold on!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Let's go together, Bright-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Alright~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Amazing!
Bright-san, you're totally
surrounded by bunnies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my? When did that happen~?
Welcome, little bunnies.

text_block_list.name: Rabbits
text_block_list.text: (Hop, hop-hop!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! They're getting away!
I'll go talk them into—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, no, never mind!
Let's just wait here together instead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Okay~.
...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—The animals aren't going anywhere, after all.
They have cages! Let's just take our time and stroll around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Tsuru-chan-sama~. You really don't have to wait for me,
you know you can just dash ahead on your own~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Eh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Your cold has finally cleared up, so you must be
so excited for your first outing in a while... aren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am just naturally slow-paced~.
I believe you would have much more fun
if you did a quick lap around first.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Being together with you makes it
way, way more fun, Bright-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, really...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
See, like the other day, I always end up getting sick
and having to spend so much time
away from our room.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So picking out outfits together for today...
Well, I spilled juice and couldn't wear it, but
even that kind of clumsy chaos was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm just so happy
to be spending time with you, Bright-san!
So let's take it easy and go slow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, my...~
Ehehe~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When evening came, I dropped by a café...
and spotted the same duo again.
However, the situation was quite different from the morning—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*...
I went all out... played way too hard...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Are you alright~?
Here, have some black tea.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Thank you ver—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —HOTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear? I am so sorry~...
Since it takes me quite a while to carry it over,
I asked them to make it as piping hot as possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
After all, if your body were to catch a chill,
you might feel even worse.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! You're so kind~~!!
Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, I'm so sorry! In the end,
our zoo trip got cut short because of me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As long as Tsuru-chan-sama is in good health
and spending time with me, that alone...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
brings me so, so~ very much
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: —We share the very same feelings, do we not, desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Yes, we definitely do!
